What are your favorite holsters? Both manufacturer, specific model, and what gun/how you use them

A Glock 36 is my EDC. Comfort and utility is important.

I typically carry it concealed in a Galco USA430 (horsehide) at the 4 o'clock RH position. The best thing about this holster is that it is very light, cool and tuckable. It's easy to tuck a dress shirt or golf shirt thus concealing my Glock. It also rides comfortably when seated even with a seat belt on.

When I know I'll be on my feet all day with shirt tail out, I'll opt for a De Santis Pro Stealth N87BJE1Z0 carried at 6 o'clock. This is a ballistic nylon holster with a magazine pouch built in. Note: 6 o'clock as the loaded Glock 36 and spare mag are a bit heavy for side carry. I found that small of back is very comfortable. Not to bad even driving. The belt clip is ambidextrous so you can carry it for right or left hand draw position.

I keep it in a Crossbreed Supertuck in horse hide that allows me to comfortably carry IWB and be able to conceal in jeans and a t-shirt. I put moleskin on my clips so they don't squeak against the horse hide.

Works great and the horse hide will hold up to a hell of a sweat if I go hiking or whatnot.
Stealthgear Onyx IWB holster. Puts all the leather-backed IWB holsters to shame. I use it to carry my FNX-45 Tactical, which is a 3lb gun, and I barely notice the weight.
http://aliengearholsters.com/ <-------- Excellent holster, excellent price, made in the USA! I carry a Ruger SR9C in an Alien Gear IWB holster.
G-Code. Kydex. Modular. It's cool if they make one for your gun it is worth having.

I bought the Alien Gear hype for my Glock 17. I liked it. The leather was ok, and it was, well, just overall okay. Then my buddy recommend L.A.G. Tactical, so I gave them a shot for my Springfield RO Compact. I love that thing. It's solid, light, and feels more secure.

I typically wear basketball shorts and a T-shirt. I can carry with my L.A.G/Springfield in the shorts. No lie. I carry it at my 3. Totally takes people by susprise. I can then move it to my back or appendix for carrying in jeans. The Alien Gear always showed through my jeans, but this one doesn't.

I still use my Alien Gear occasionally, but it's not for me. The LAG I will show and tell everyone about.

I have Kholster horse leather IWB I use for 4 o clock carry I really like. I carry a SIG P239 in that. Unfortunately they are no longer in business, but galco and crossbreed are supposed to be similar.

I'm thinking of buying the 3rd generation Alien Gear IWB holsters for a couple subcompact pistols I want to carry IWB. I find their material choices interesting (fake leather with patterning for grip on the front, neoprene for comfort in the back, steel band inside for rigidity), and their price is excellent; especially since I'm in the market for two holsters and they have a deal for that. I also like their guarantees and life long kydex shell swap for new pistols. Next time this thread comes up I'll report how they work for me.
G-code INCOG Eclipse by Haley Strategic. I wear it in front but you can wear it at any position. I love the clips they use. http://imgur.com/qcXGx1i
